items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I think I went on the street for Moe Gale at the Famous Door with Art Tatum. I worked there for three months.

ctx.x: Because after I had came back -- now this puts it altogether. After I had came back with the Lunceford thing, I came back and I was still doing some writing. I always went back to that writing that rock and roll stuff, you know. Rhythm and blues back there, you know. And Moe Gale wanted me to -- I think I went on the street for Moe Gale at the Famous Door with Art Tatum. I worked there for three months.
Yeah. That was the winter of 1944, because in '45 -- '44 --
